text: Documented RESTful API gives programmatic access to workspace meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries for building custom integrations
quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.

text: API keys can be limited to specific note access scopes chosen when the key is created
quote: When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.

text: Admins on Business and Enterprise plans can create non-expiring API keys that belong to the workspace rather than a user
quote: Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys. These belong to the workspace rather than an individual user, don't expire

text: Build custom AI agents on meeting data to analyze sentiment, surface recurring feedback themes, or combine meetings with other data sources
quote: Custom AI agents - Build agents that analyze sentiment across your calls, surface recurring themes in product feedback, or combine meeting context with other data sources for deeper insights.

text: Official Granola MCP connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools so they can query notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights
quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to your Granola meeting notes via MCP. Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.

text: Granola Chat answers natural-language questions across all meetings, a single meeting, or a set such as a folder
quote: You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder

text: Chat can spot patterns across customer calls and generate follow-up outputs from meeting notes
quote: Chat with your meeting notes to recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls, and generate follow-up outputs.

text: Chat can draft and send follow-up emails and Slack messages and schedule Google Calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent
quote: Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.

text: Favorite prompts can be saved as reusable recipes and run with one click
quote: you can save your favorite prompts as recipes and run them with a single click.

text: Users can pick or create note templates for specific call types such as 1:1s, interviews, or sales pitches
quote: While Granola's default summarisation adapts to a range of formats, you might want to choose a specific template (or set up your own!) for a specific type of call: for instance, 1:1s, interviews or sales pitches.

text: During a call, typing / in the notes opens a menu for choosing a template
quote: During a call, type `/` in your meeting notes to open the context menu and select a template.

text: Enhanced notes are generated automatically when the call ends or when the user stops it manually
quote: Once Granola has recognised your call has ended, or you stop it manually, it will automatically generate enhanced notes.

text: Notes typed during the conversation guide how the AI-enhanced notes are generated
quote: You can write your own notes in Granola as your conversation is happening, to help guide how the AI-enhanced notes will be generated.

text: A magnifying glass beside each note shows where in the transcript or raw notes it came from
quote: Use the magnifying glass beside each note to see where in the transcript or raw notes the note came from

text: Notes and history can be exported to CSV with titles, summaries, transcripts, and details for backup, migration, or GDPR portability
quote: Export your Granola meeting notes to CSV. Get note titles, summaries, transcripts, and details. Useful for backups, migration, or GDPR data portability requests.

text: Granola connects to more than 8,000 apps to automate what happens after a meeting
quote: Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting

text: Notes can be fed into Notion, Confluence, or a wiki to keep team knowledge searchable
quote: Feed meeting notes into Notion, Confluence, or a wiki so your team's knowledge is searchable and current.

text: Action items can be extracted from notes and automatically turned into tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or other project tools
quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.

text: Notes added to folders sync automatically to the matching HubSpot contacts, companies, or deals
quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.

text: Transcription and summaries support 31 languages on desktop and 17 on mobile
quote: Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).

text: Transcripts can be auto-deleted after a chosen period from 1 day to 1 year, while notes are kept
quote: Choose a retention period from the dropdown: 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year

text: Notes can be permanently deleted, and accidentally deleted notes can be restored
quote: Delete or restore Granola meeting notes. Permanently remove notes or recover accidentally deleted ones.

text: Users can opt out of model training at any time in Settings
quote: You can opt out of model training at any time.

text: Granola is HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers that handle PHI
quote: Granola is HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers. If your organization needs to store or process Protected Health Information (PHI), reach out to sales@granola.so

text: Notes are private unless the user shares a link or adds the note to a team-space folder
quote: Your notes are never shared with any participants unless you share the link, or add the note to a folder in your team space.

text: The sidebar separates a private My notes space from a team workspace whose folders are visible to all members
quote: The Granola sidebar is organized into two spaces: My notes — Your private space... [Your workspace name] — Your team space.

text: Copy link creates a unique shareable URL for a meeting's notes
quote: Copy link will copy a unique URL link to the meeting notes, which you can send to others.

text: Speaker tags show each participant's name above their part of the transcript instead of Me/Them labels
quote: Speaker tags show each participant's name above their parts of the conversation, giving you more detailed attribution than the default Me and Them labels.

text: The mobile app takes AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings and, on iOS, phone calls
quote: Granola for mobile lets you take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings (and, on iOS, phone calls).

text: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and every other meeting app
quote: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.

text: Captures computer audio directly, so no bot joins the meeting
quote: Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot

text: Can capture in-person meetings, voice memos, and any audio playing on the computer, such as podcasts or videos
quote: in-person meetings; voice memos to yourself; any audio playing off your computer like a podcast or YouTube video

text: Posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts so participants are informed
quote: Granola posts a message in your meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know.

text: Connects to Google Calendar or Outlook to show upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and provide meeting context
quote: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook to Granola. See upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and get meeting context.

text: A meeting notification opens the video call URL and the Granola note, then starts transcribing
quote: Clicking the notification will: Open the URL for the video call from the calendar event; Open your Granola note for that meeting, and start transcribing

text: Prepares overnight meeting briefs with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points
quote: Granola preps you for your meetings overnight. Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points

text: After external meetings, automatically drafts a follow-up email using the transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads, ready to send in a couple of clicks
quote: After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email - using context from your transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads - so you can send it in a couple of clicks.

text: Can take screenshots of shared screens during meetings, attach them to the note, and use them to improve the notes
quote: Granola takes snapshots of what's being presented, attaches them to your note, and uses them to improve your meeting notes.

text: Users can keep work and personal notes separate by having both kinds of account
quote: or have both to keep work and personal notes separate.
